description: Land Acquisition -Bandara, Tumpane, D/S Division, Kandy District Sec 05
categorisation: This gazette content is primarily about land acquisition under the Land Acquisition Act. It contains detailed descriptions of specific land parcels being acquired for public purpose, including their locations, boundaries, extents, and survey information. While it mentions a government minister (Nalaka Jude Harin Fernando) in his official capacity, the core content focuses entirely on land matters rather than government personnel changes or portfolio responsibilities, making it a Land Gazette (Type 4).
